tldr: Moon through the 10th house brings focus to career, reputation, authority, and public contribution.
body: Moon transiting the 10th house stirs career, reputation, authority, and public contribution. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports visibility, leadership, and professional direction: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or measuring worth only by public success.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 10th house deliberately. Work with career, reputation, authority, and public contribution without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
